subject: Meteorology
title: Updrafts and Downdrafts
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Updrafts and Downdrafts.

hook.text: Inside a thunderstorm, powerful updrafts and downdrafts exist side by side—an invisible vertical battle.

buildup.text: Updrafts carry warm, moist air upward—condensation releases latent heat, fueling the updraft further.

discovery.text: Downdrafts form when rain drags air downward and evaporation cools it, making it heavier than surroundings.

twist.text: When the downdraft hits the ground, it spreads out as a gust front—the sudden cool wind before a storm hits.

climax.text: In severe storms, updrafts and downdrafts separate spatially—this prevents self-destruction and keeps storms alive.

punchline.text: Up and down fight inside every storm cloud.

quiz.question: What causes a gust front?
options: Downdraft spreading out at the surface
